snippet.title: ArMystic | Wishlist Now on Steam
snippet.description:
Wishlist ArMystic on steam today!

Steam page - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4731960/ArMystic/

For the past couple years I have been working on ArMystic. An exploration RPG built around mystery and discovery in a world ridden with spiritual disease and delusion.

The game takes inspiration from many surreal late '90s and early 2000s adventure games, such as LSD: Dream Emulator, OFF, and Yume Nikki. The game does not hold your hand and is built around unraveling the nature of a world completely alien. Explore at your leisure and engage in conflict at your own discretion. 

The environments vary in style and structure, with an overall mixed media aesthetic. I hand drew and sculpted enemies, levels, and animations from clay, photo collage, VHS footage, and pen and ink. I used Blender and Photoshop, along with older programs like Kid Pix, in order to create a liminal dreamscape.

Demo coming soon.

You can follow for updates on Youtube and my Instagram.
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/very_bored_kid/
